verdict.rationale: The evidence pack only covers generic `terraform state` CLI commands and local state mapping (terraform-docs-6, terraform-docs-20) plus a community complaint about setting up backend state (terraform-comm-5) — none of it documents remote backends, state locking, or concurrent-run protection. Missing for 10: any docs/tests referencing S3/Consul/Terraform Cloud remote backends, state locking mechanism, or a hands-on probe demonstrating locking prevents concurrent corruption.
